scope: Current production resolvers core/WoG/Wrath/TUM registered identities only. No activation, no stats patch, no claim all240cfg are ported.

provenance.nativeLoader: CCreatureHandler.cpp530..604 loads legacy numeric columns;625..665 creates base bonuses then abilities and XP
provenance.archivePriority: config/filesystem.json loads H3bitmap.lod after H3ab_bmp.lod and explicitly documents SoD overriding AB

limitations: Offline merged definitions, not a live serialization of BonusSystem objects. Intrinsic stat modifiers explicitly listed as noncomparable rather than approximated.
Conditional mod settings/submods beyond production resolver inputs, ERM runtime stat mutation, hero/artifact/terrain/rank effects are not included.
A numeric source/native difference is a source3.5 rebalance candidate, not proof of intentional rebalance or a safe patch.
Original executable default flags absent cfg are not guessed; flags and XP compare semantically, never by raw-array equality.
